# Boiling Point of Water at Sea Level

At sea level (standard atmospheric pressure of 101.325 kPa), water boils at **100°C** (which equals 212°F or 373.15 K on the Kelvin scale).

## Quick Facts
- **1 atm = 101.325 kPa** — the standard pressure at sea level
- The Celsius scale was originally defined by setting **0°C = freezing point of water** and **100°C = boiling point of water** (at 1 atm)
